title: Role Entry Points And Formation Gate
non_product_work: Implement the first bounded role-scoped workflow orchestration slice by adding explicit Repo PM and Work Item PM entrypoints, a role-required refusal for bare workflow invocation, deterministic Formation Gate validation, formation review artifacts, formation approval state, Work Item PM readiness checks, and supported replaced bootstrap-gap disposition semantics.
origin: The 2026-06-01 role-scoped workflow orchestration design and accepted decision record identify BANDIT-GAP-STAGE4-REPAIR-OWNERSHIP-ENFORCEMENT as a symptom of overloaded PM authority. BANDIT-GAP-ROLE-SCOPED-WORKFLOW-ORCHESTRATION is the accepted replacement umbrella, but the current bootstrap-gap ledger cannot yet record a replaced disposition without abusing no_action.
scope: Add supported `replaced` bootstrap-gap disposition semantics so BANDIT-GAP-STAGE4-REPAIR-OWNERSHIP-ENFORCEMENT can be honestly replaced by BANDIT-GAP-ROLE-SCOPED-WORKFLOW-ORCHESTRATION after this work lands and closes out.

Add explicit role entrypoints for Repo PM formation work and Work Item PM execution orchestration, with role naming and command surfaces aligned to docs/design/role-scoped-workflow-orchestration.md and docs/decisions/2026-06-01-explicit-role-entrypoints-and-formation-gate.md.
Make bare Bandit workflow invocation fail closed with a concise role-required refusal instead of hydrating roadmap, gap, or work-item context and inferring authority role.

Add the first Repo PM work-item creation entrypoint, expected as `repo-pm create-work-item <spec-path>`, while preserving the existing `work-item create <spec-path>` behavior unless explicitly deprecated by the scoped implementation.

Add a Repo PM formation approval entrypoint, expected as `repo-pm approve-formation <work-item-id>`, that records `formation_approved` as an append-only coordination step transition only after deterministic validation and required formation review evidence pass.

Add deterministic Formation Gate validation for formed work items, including work-item type, source provenance, narrow scope, verifiable acceptance criteria, out-of-scope boundaries, operator input status, role contract references where available, write-surface families, Test Writer and Implementation Writer boundaries, and execution readiness.

Define and require formation review artifacts at docs/work/<ID>/qwen-formation-review.md, docs/work/<ID>/coderabbit-formation-review.md, and docs/work/<ID>/formation-review.md before Work Item PM can start.

Add Work Item PM readiness checks, expected as `work-item-pm start <work-item-id>` or equivalent, that refuse work items without `formation_approved` coordination history and approved formation evidence.
Record the glossary and decision updates needed to describe Repo PM, Work Item PM, Formation Gate, formation-approved coordination state, and role-required entrypoint boundaries.

Preserve existing repo-native state authority: .bandit/bootstrap-gaps.json, per-work-item coordination history, CURRENT_CONTEXT.md, ROADMAP.md, STATUS.md, and work-item artifacts remain canonical; projections and command payloads remain derived.
Record CLEAN_CODE.md read evidence in Stage 1; CLEAN_CODE.md was read on 2026-06-01 before creating this brief, and clean-code compliance must be evaluated before landing.

Stage capability scope for this chore: Codex PM owns Stage 1 brief creation, Stage 2 RED evidence, routine technical routing, and context-artifact synchronization; if Codex authors or materially edits Stage 2 RED tests, Stage 3 implementation is assigned to Claude through the bootstrap Process Adapter path; the Stage 3 Writer has no authority to edit tests, test helpers, fixtures, RED evidence, or acceptance mappings; reviewers own Stage 4 evidence; Landing Agent owns Stage 5 verdict/action evidence.

Token-cost failsafe boundary: use existing Token-Cost Failsafe policy for abnormal-run guardrails if paid, high-token, reviewer, or long-running execution becomes necessary; this chore must not approve new provider-pricing evidence, spend-class approval, paid reviewer promotion, recurring paid routing, or operator-owned cost/risk overrides.

Future-work scope: this chore must not implement full PRD decomposition, broad claimability or unblocking repair, full role contracts, Role Run Manifests, execution packets beyond minimal readiness checks, role input packets, diff-based write validation, same-agent repair continuation, landing subagent packets, closeout packets, full monolithic rubric migration, state-index persistence, local server/API mode, scheduler execution, worktree lifecycle execution, claim lease creation or release, work-surface reservation implementation, PR/CI workflow, automatic merge/push/deploy behavior, product UAT approval, dependency or lockfile changes, installed global skill edits, external service integration, or unrelated Phase 8 cockpit feature work.
acceptance_criteria: The chore brief exists at docs/work/<ID>/brief.md and links the current open BANDIT-GAP-STAGE4-REPAIR-OWNERSHIP-ENFORCEMENT ledger entry to the accepted BANDIT-GAP-ROLE-SCOPED-WORKFLOW-ORCHESTRATION replacement umbrella.

Stage 1 brief evidence records CLEAN_CODE.md read evidence, Stage Capability Scope requirements, Codex-owned technical decisions, source hierarchy, role-required entrypoint boundary, Formation Gate boundary, replaced-disposition boundary, Work Item PM readiness boundary, source-of-truth boundary, and Token-Cost Failsafe boundary.

Focused RED evidence proves the current failure modes: unsupported replaced bootstrap-gap disposition, no explicit role-required workflow entrypoint refusal, no Repo PM create-work-item entrypoint, no formation approval gate, no deterministic formation validation, no formation review artifact requirement, no formation-approved coordination transition, and no Work Item PM readiness refusal before formation approval.

`replaced` bootstrap-gap disposition support validates source gap, replacement gap, replacement work item or artifact evidence, rationale, and verification target without treating replaced gaps as resolved implementation work or no-action decisions.
Bare role-less Bandit workflow invocation fails closed with a concise role-required message and does not hydrate roadmap, gap ledger, or work-item state before a role is selected.
Repo PM work-item creation creates the same safe work-item artifacts as the existing CLI-owned work-item creation path while making Repo PM formation authority explicit.

Formation approval cannot be recorded unless deterministic formation validation passes and required formation review artifacts exist with blocker findings absent or repaired and non-blocking findings dispositioned.

`formation_approved` is recorded as append-only coordination history between `brief_created` and RED evidence stages; it is not stored as a mutable flag, projection-only state, or inferred from artifact presence alone.

Work Item PM start/readiness checks refuse unknown work items, missing briefs, missing formation validation, missing formation review, blocker formation findings, missing operator-owned input, missing `formation_approved` transition, and stale or contradictory coordination evidence.
Formation review scope is limited to work formation quality and does not review implementation code or authorize execution-stage repairs.

The implementation preserves Permanent Test Ownership Boundary and Bootstrap Model-Family Separation: if Codex authors or materially edits Stage 2 RED tests, Stage 3 implementation goes to Claude, and the Stage 3 Writer cannot edit tests, test helpers, fixtures, RED evidence, or acceptance mappings.
Stage 4 review evidence uses pre-PR CodeRabbit and Local Qwen at the current review-subject hash unless honest provider refusal or bootstrap-gap evidence is recorded.

Layered risk-classification and supply-chain gate evidence are recorded before landing because this chore changes workflow entrypoints, validation, coordination state, and bootstrap-gap disposition semantics.
Clean-code compliance is evaluated before landing; any accepted non-blocking concern becomes a tagged follow-up or explicit no-action decision.

BANDIT-GAP-STAGE4-REPAIR-OWNERSHIP-ENFORCEMENT is only formally replaced after landing action and retrospective closeout evidence exist for this work item and after the new replaced disposition support can validate the replacement evidence.

No full PRD decomposition, role-run manifest system, execution packet system, diff-based write validation, same-agent repair continuation, landing/closeout packet system, scheduler, worktree lifecycle, claim lease, work-surface reservation, automatic merge/push/deploy, product UAT approval, dependency or lockfile change, local server/API mode, installed global skill edit, external service integration, or unrelated Phase 8 cockpit feature work is introduced.

operator_input_status: No operator-owned input is required before creating this bootstrap-gap chore or writing RED evidence. Repo artifacts identify the Stage 4 repair ownership violation, the accepted role-scoped workflow replacement design, the source artifacts, the Stage Capability Scope boundary, the Token-Cost Failsafe boundary, the Evidence Freshness SLO boundary, and the Codex PM authority to route routine workflow-entrypoint and formation-gate implementation mechanics. Halt only if implementation would change product direction, UAT policy, workflow policy beyond enforcing the accepted role-scoped orchestration design, business tradeoffs, explicit cost/risk posture, provider-pricing approval, spend-class approval, paid reviewer promotion, recurring paid routing policy, external service setup, live routing policy, claim authority, worktree lifecycle authority, installed global skill contents, dependency or lockfile policy, merge/push/deploy authority, or broader cockpit/product scope.

forbidden_actions: Do not write RED evidence before this Stage 1 brief exists.
Do not let Stage 3 Writer edit tests, test helpers, fixtures, RED evidence, or acceptance mappings.
Do not infer Work Item PM readiness from brief existence alone.
Do not treat `replaced` as resolved implementation work or no-action.

Do not implement full role-run manifests, execution packets, claim leases, worktrees, scheduler execution, merge, push, deploy, dependency changes, external services, or unrelated cockpit features in this chore.

soft_budget_bands: Stage 2 RED evidence and Stage 3 implementation should use existing abnormal-run soft budget guidance; do not set brittle caps that force duplicate attempts.
Stage 4 reviewer runs may be long-running or provider-dependent and must record continuation or provider-refusal evidence honestly.
provider_pricing_evidence: No new paid provider-pricing evidence is approved by this work-item brief.
Any paid reviewer, paid model, or recurring paid route remains blocked unless a separate approved provider-pricing and spend-class artifact exists.
continuation_decisions: If CodeRabbit or another external reviewer times out, record explicit provider-refusal or continuation evidence instead of treating absence as pass.
If token or cost failsafe trips, halt the expensive action and record the continuation decision before retrying.
